name: Victoria Spartz
summary: Victoria Spartz (née Kulheyko; born October 6, 1978) is a Ukrainian-born American politician and businesswoman who is the U.S. representative for Indiana's 5th congressional district. Spartz is a member of the Republican Party, and in the House, served on its Judiciary Committee (with subcommittee interests related to immigration and administrative, regulatory, and antitrust issues). She previously represented the 20th district in the Indiana Senate.
